newsitem.title: UK: UK gas users face unchanged interruptions on Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: UK gas users face unchanged interruptions on Jan 7.

text.p: A TransCo spokesman said on Monday that British gas customers with interruptible contracts will face the same level of interruption on Tuesday as on Monday.

All interruptible contract holders in the South West Local Distribution Zone (LDZ), 70 percent of customers in the South Wales LDZ and cutomers with Network Sensitive Loads in a further 5 LDZs will be told to continue not using gas in the day from 06.00 GMT on Tuesday.

TransCo is the transport and distribution arm of British Gas plc. Interruptible contracts are cheaper for end users than guaranteed or firm contracts, but they carry the risk that supplies will be cut to meet peak demand elesewhere in the system.
